ci: Participant-cluster percentile 95% CI; pooled resampling stratified by cohort; fixed OOF predictions, no refitting
point_estimates: Scan-weighted; all participant visits kept together in bootstrap
limitations: Upstream ComBat used all scans and age covariates; this is not fold-contained harmonization.
Intervals condition on fitted models and existing model/threshold selection; no model-retraining uncertainty or significance claim.
HABS paired benchmark has only 13 participants; ADDecode has no saved CN OOF predictions for any model.
Slide snapshots preserve displayed historical values; IG tables describe reconstructed models, not verified original checkpoints.
CSV and HTML retain exact slide-table Unicode; PDF mathematical glyph support depends on installed fonts.
